provenance.hashInput: Every acquired byte, before ZIP/CSV decoding
provenance.dates: HTTP Last-Modified and ETag are validators, not declared publication dates. acquisitionDate/observedAt record acquisition; checkedAt records validation. Raw-input sidecars retain each file's acquisitionDate, byteSize, URL and SHA-256.

semantics.validity: Registry validity intersects the requested calendar year, not only the current date.
semantics.absence: No observed municipal movement: null total/title vector. Observed zero: integer zero, including all-zero observed months.
semantics.population: Registry population <= 1 or unavailable is null; population reference date is not declared.
semantics.period: Pure monthly flows; cumulative is their sum, not the difference of snapshots. Missing months are not imputed as zero; the current year can be partial.
semantics.geography: Legal seat of the municipality, not the physical destination or origin of each transaction.
semantics.nonGoals: Incasso is not accertamento or competenza. No cash balance, fiscal residual, efficiency, waste or quality claim; do not sum receipts and expenditure.
